children: AIB Group's third-quarter net interest income beat was "reassuringly straightforward," Barclays' Aman Rakkar writes. The Irish bank's beat and 2026 guidance raise bode well for 2027 net interest income, which is likely to be helped by further rate rises and balance sheet growth, the analyst says. Underlying fee income was slightly soft in the third quarter, Barclays notes. However, investors are likely to welcome the stronger net interest income print and outlook, Rakkar says. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
